name: docs init and YAML feature store
description:
RepoDocsCli scaffold on RepoCli.Core: .repo-docs/ with repo.yaml, one {feature}.yaml per feature, config.yaml, .gitignore for the lock.
YamlDotNet; tool owns formatting (comments not preserved). git add / git mv like issues; lock for concurrent writes. init prefills a feature per Features/{X}/ with when.paths.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged 4aa4d1d. YAML: camelCase keys, kebab-case enums, strict deserialization (unknown keys are errors, so new fields need a model property first). Ids are kebab-case and match file names; 'repo'/'config' reserved. Prefilled features are 'shipped'. Store mutations don't take the lock themselves: callers wrap load/modify/save in Lock(). JSON status is kebab-case to match files. No shared docs command base yet (add with #27/#28; map DocsFileException to an exit code). CI does not pack/publish RepoDocsCli yet. Also fixed Git.Remove throwing when git rm removed the folder.
